title: Reese Training Program
author: Mike
desc: This is Reese's premium Whaley gym Training program designed to build muscle with some cables and some dumbbells.

ex.note: Controlled descent, accelerate moving upwards. Hips can shift back, take path of least resistance. Can be dumbbell/barbell

ss.note: Dumbbell path to lower chest, stack elbows under the dumbbell. Can substitute with push-ups 4xAMRAP
Shoulder width grip, some cheat is ok
Bend at hips not the lower back. Start with hands behind head, hold weight behind head progressively. Any weighted ab crunch
Standing on step. One hand for dumbbell, other for support. Lock hips and knees. If doing seated, place two dumbbells on knees

ex.note: Push hips up and back as you lower bar, drive stomach into quads

ss.note: Raise until arm is nearly vertical. Strict, controlled form here. Can be bent over/standing upright
Slight arch in back, push hips down and aim for big hip bend. Controlled, yet forceful upward motion
Grip just inside shoulder width. Can substitute with chest flies 4x10-15
Standing, just outside shoulder width grip. Strict press
Emphasize the upward movement, elbows flared slightly
Standing on step. One hand for dumbbell, other for support. Lock hips and knees. If doing seated, place two dumbbells on knees
